Pseudoracemes axillary, few-flowered, divided near the base into 3 sub- equal branches, the branches 6-12 cm long, sparsely pubescent to glabrous, the trichomes sessile or short-stalked, the arms much flattened; bracts narrowly tri- angular, to ca. 1.5 mm long, sparsely pubescent; bracteoles minute, ovate-tri- angular; pedicels 2-9 mm long, densely pubescent. Flowers yellow, 14-21 mm in diam., the sepals with the lobes oblong to ovate, 4-5 mm long, rounded at the apex, almost glabrous, weakly ciliate, with 8-9 glands ca. 2 mm long; petals clawed, the blade more or less rounded, erose along the margin, the outermost 4 petals 7.0-9.5 mm long, the innermost 8-9 mm long; stamens 4-5 mm long, connate in basal ?3-?/2, the anthers 1.2-1.4 mm long, the connective yellow; ovary 3-locular, 1.5-2.0 mm long, glabrous or crustose-puberulent, the styles ca. 4 mm long, connate, thickened at the apex. Fruits subglobose, glabrous, 11-12 mm long, 13-15 mm in diam., orange, turning red at maturity.

Shrub or small tree, 2-3 m tall, to 8 cm d.b.h; stems sparsely and inconspic- uously appressed-pubescent, the trichomes very short, T-shaped. Leaves oppo- site, coriaceous, narrowly elliptic-lanceolate, acute to gradually acuminate at the apex, attenuate at the base, 4.0-9.5 cm long, 1.5-3.0 cm wide, both surfaces minutely and densely reddish-brown, glandular dotted upon magnification, the upper surface glabrous except sparsely appressed-pubescent along the midrib, the lower surface almost glabrous or sparsely appressed-pubescent with 1 or more pairs of sunken, plate-shaped glands near the base and with others scattered elsewhere on the blade, especially near the major veins, the margin revolute, the primary lateral veins 2-4 pairs, mostly arising in the lower ?3 of the blade, then markedly ascending to near the apex; petioles almost glabrous or sparsely ap- pressed-pubescent, 8-11 mm long. Pseudoracemes axillary, 6-7-flowered, 4-7 cm long, the axis inconspicuously and sparsely appressed-pubescent, the tri- chomes thick; bracts narrowly triangular, thick, sparsely pubescent, the brac- teoles similar. Flowers not studied; fruiting calyx with 6-8 glands, several of them the result of fusion of 2 glands, the glands narrowly obovate, 3.5-4.5 mm long, the calyx obtuse at the apex, glabrous to sparsely and inconspicuously appressed-pubescent, ciliate. Fruits obovoid to ovoid, ca. 1 cm long, reddish- orange, glabrous.

Tree, 6-20 m tall, 15-30 cm d.b.h. Leaves opposite, glabrous, clustered at ends of branchlets, obovate to elliptic or oblong, 5-10 cm long, 1.8-5.0 cm wide, bluntly short-acuminate, acute and decurrent at base; petioles 0.3-0.8 cm long; stipules connate into a triangular axillary ligule, 2.0-2.5 mm long. Pseudoracemes terminal, to 8 cm long; axis, pedicels, bracts, and sepals ferruginous appressed- pubescent; bracts ovate, 1.5-2.0 mm long; bracteoles narrowly ovate, ca. 1.5 mm long; pedicels to 8 mm long. Flowers many, pink, ca. 1.5 cm in diam.; sepals 5, triangular, ca. 2.2 mm long, 2.5 mm wide, each bearing 2 oblong glands which are reflexed at the apex; petals 5, pink, glabrous, clawed, the blade suborbicular, ca. 6 mm in diam., concave, the margin irregular; stamens 10, subequal, the filaments ca. 1.8 mm long, pilose at the base, the anthers introrse, non-alate, ca. 1 mm long, the connective with a thickened, long, exserted appendage; ovary glabrous, ca. 2 mm long, the styles 3, distinct, ca. 3 mm long. Drupes ovoid, ca. 1 cm long, green (immature).

Liana; stems inconspicuously puberulous, glabrous, weakly lenticellate. Leaves opposite, elliptic to ovate-elliptic, acuminate at the apex, rounded to obtuse at the base, 14-16 cm long, 6.5-8 cm wide, thinly chartaceous, glabrous on the upper side, glabrate beneath, the midrib sunken on the upper side; major lateral veins 5 or 6 pairs, arcuate-ascending, faintly loop-connected toward the apex; petioles 1-1.5 cm long, bearing 2 pairs of small glands. Inflorescences terminal, the umbels arranged in racemes, the branches, peduncles and pedicels densely and shortly reddish-brown tomentose; peduncles to ca. 3 mm long; ped- icels to ca. 1 cm long (in fruit), articulate. Flowers not known; fruiting calyx with glands oblong, to ca. 4 mm long. Samaras (3.5-)4.5-5.8 cm long, 1.5-2.1 cm wide, well attenuated toward the base, weakly appressed-pubescent to glabrous, the pubescence denser on the dorsal margin and on the body, the dorsal thickened margin straight or slightly curved, the ventral margin thin, gradually curved to the base, usually with a prominent lobe near the base, the body 7-8 mm long, semi-obovoid, dark reddish-brown, transversely ridged about midway with small- er longitudinal ridges.

Liana, the young stems densely ferruginous tomentose, the internodes to 5 cm long. Leaves opposite, obovate, rounded and cuspidate to short acuminate at the apex, rounded to subcordate at the base, 12-28 cm long, 6-17 cm wide, glabrous or nearly so on the upper surface except on the veins, densely hirsute- villous below; petioles 1.5-3 cm long; stipules subulate, borne near the apex of the petiole. Inflorescence axillary, umbelliform-fasciculate; peduncle usually to 6 cm long, 1-few-flowered; pedicels ca. 2 cm long, densely hirtellous, bracteate at the base. Flowers yellow; sepals densely hispid, blunt, to 3 mm long, 4 of them bearing 2 whitish disciform glands ca. 1.5 mm long; sexual parts of flower not studied. Infructescence with peduncles short or to 10 mm long, 1-several-flow- ered; pedicels 20-23 mm long, the peduncles and pedicels densely tomentose, the lateral wings depressed-ovate to suborbicular, hyaline, membranaceous, drying pale brown, radially veined, sparsely patulous, pubescent with T-shaped tri- chomes, the margin straight to minutely sinuate, 4.5-5.5 cm long, 2.5-3.2 cm high, the veins prominulous, anastomosing toward the margin of the wing, the dorsal wing much reduced, triangular, to 4.5 mm high, the seminiferous area densely hispid with stiff, straight, pointed trichomes.

Large canopy lianas; trunk 10 cm or more broad; dark brown, densely len- ticellate, all but the older stems densely ferruginous tomentose. Leaves opposite, obovate, rounded and cuspidate to short-acuminate at the apex, tapered to a narrow, cuneate, rounded or subcordate base, 12-45(-67) cm long, 6-22(-28) cm wide, glabrous above except on the veins, densely hirsute-villous beneath with branched trichomes, with 9-14 pairs of major lateral veins, impressed above, raised below; petioles densely tomentose, 0.5-2.0 cm long, bearing a pair of prominent subulate stipules at about the middle on the upper side. Inflorescence axillary, of stalked umbels; peduncles short or to 8 mm long, 2-4 per axil; pe- duncles, pedicels and calyx densely tomentose; pedicels 1-2 cm long, with thick T-shaped trichomes. Flowers 5-parted; sepals blunt, to 3 mm long, eglandular or 4 of them bearing 2 red-orange, shiny, ovate glands to 1.5 mm long; petals yellow, clawed, fimbriate, the petal opposite the eglandular sepal held somewhat erect and marked with orange, its fimbriate margins gland-tipped; stamens 10, of 2 lengths, shorter than the styles and curling after the anthers have fallen; styles 3, interspersed with dense straight trichomes, 2 twisted to either side of the erect petal, the stigma subterminal. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, the lateral wing subreniform or broadly obovate-elliptic, firmly membranaceous, radially veined, erose at the margin, 12-18 mm long, 7-10 mm wide, the dorsal wing much re- duced, triangular, thickened to the base, 1.5-2.0 mm high, to 2.5 mm long, the seminiferous area dorsally tuberculate and densely hispid with stiff straight, point- ed trichomes; between lateral and dorsal wings, usually 1 or 2 thin, linear appen- dices ca. 2-3 mm long.

Lianas or arching shrubs to 2.5 m tall; stem sericeous, with weak interpetiolar ridges and also with slender ribs extending downward from the petioles, the trichomes brown, T-shaped. Leaves opposite, oblong-elliptic, gradually acumi- nate (the acumen acute to rounded at the apex and apiculate with the margins rolled inward), acute to obtuse at the base, 9-12 cm long, 3.0-4.5 cm wide, above glabrous, drying dark brown, beneath densely tan-brown sericeous, the trichomes T-shaped, short, completely contiguous; primary lateral veins 10-12 pairs, ar- cuate-ascending to the margins; the secondary veins moderately obscure; petioles 7-10 mm long, conspicuously canaliculate, sericeous to tomentose, with a pair of plate shaped glands borne adaxially near the apex; stipules subulate, borne near the apex on the upper surface. Inflorescence of axillary umbels; peduncles 6-8 mm long, sericeous; bracts narrowly triangular-ovate, ca. 2 mm long, densely pubescent; bracteoles ovate, ca. 1 mm long, pubescent; pedicels slender, 10-12 mm long, sericeous to weakly patulous-pubescent, the T-shaped trichomes short and stout. Flowers with the calyx lacking obvious glands, the sepals ca. 2 mm long, obtuse at the apex, densely appressed-pubescent outside and glabrous with- in, folding along the middle when drying; petals not seen. Schizocarp of 3 sa- maras, each samara with 2 large lateral wings, these orbicular-auriculate, mem- branaceous, 2.5-3.0 cm long, 2.0-2.5 cm wide, drying orange-brown, thinly appressed, silvery-pubescent, the veins prominulous, the outer margin smoothly irregular, the dorsal wing absent or scarcely more than 1 mm high, the semini- ferous area 3-4 mm long, densely pubescent.

Lianas, most parts except upper leaf surface densely pubescent with T-shaped trichomes, those of the stems, petioles, peduncles, pedicels and calyces appearing appressed-pubescent; periderm of older stems thin, reddish-brown, becoming fis- sured. Leaves opposite, sublanceolate-elliptic to elliptic, acute or gradually long- acuminate, ovate to subcordate at the base, mostly 8-25 cm long, 4-11 cm wide, glabrous above except the midrib, softly pubescent throughout below with stalked T-shaped trichomes, the midrib and major veins appressed-pubescent; petioles 1-2 cm long with 2 sessile glands at the apex; 2 subulate stipules to 2 mm long borne at about the middle of the petiole. Inflorescence of solitary, axillary umbels; small bracteoles borne at the apex of peduncles; peduncle 2.5-4.0 cm long, thick, rigid, pubescent with (6-)35-60 flowers; bracts 2, subulate, 2.5 mm long; brac- teoles ovate-oblong, 2 mm long; pedicels 13-20 mm long. Flowers 10-12 mm diam.; sepals triangular-ovate, 4 of them sometimes with 2 large glands; petals clawed, the blade ovate-suborbicular, yellow except orange-red at the base, sub- cordate at the base, 4-5 mm diam., the margin sinuate, all but the inner small one also fimbriate, the inner one orange-red; stamens 10, subequal; styles 3, 1 erect, 2 curved, the apices narrowly spatulate-truncate with the outer angle acute or shortly apiculate, the ovary hirsute. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, softly hirsute especially on the body; wings lateral, reniform, 0.5-2.0 cm long, 2.0-3.8 cm wide, thin, the outer margin sinuate-undulate.

Lianas, wide ranging in forest over low vegetation or pendant from larger trees; younger--parts, including peduncles, pedicels, and calyces densely pubes- cent with T-shaped trichomes. Leaves opposite, obovate-oblong, elliptic or ob- ovate, acute or rounded at the apex, sometimes acuminate especially when young, tapered to an obtuse or subcordate base, 5-15(-22) cm long, 2.5-8.5 cm wide, glabrate to sparsely pubescent on surface below, the veins below densely ap- pressed-pubescent; petioles usually ca. 5 mm long, with paired sessile glands near the apex; stipules subulate, borne about midway up the petiole, slender, 3-5 mm long. Inflorescences cymose panicles, axillary, small; flowers in small umbels 1.8-2.2 cm wide; peduncles nearly obsolete or 1-5 mm long, appressed-pubes- cent; bracts and bracteoles ovate, acute, pubescent, to 1.5 mm long; pedicels 9- 25 mm long. Flowers with the sepals triangular to ovate, all but one usually bearing prominent, stalked glands, these greenish-yellow, round to ellipsoid, ca. 1.5 mm long; petals yellow, often marked with orange near the base, membrana- ceous, glabrous, 4.5-7.0 mm long, clawed, the blade orbicular, the petal opposite the glandless sepal with a fimbriate margin; stamens 10, glabrous, of irregular sizes, some directed inward beneath the styles; styles 3, flattened, curved, to 4.5 mm long, the apex subtruncate-spatulate with the inner angle protruding and stigmatic, the dorsal angle apiculate; lobes of the ovary densely pubescent. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, the wings lateral, orbicular to reniform, 1.2-1.6 cm long, 2-3 cm wide, membranaceous, with sparse appressed T-shaped trichomes and prominent reticulate veins, the margin sinuate; seminiferous area subcuneate, sparsely setaceous, the dorsal crest 2 mm high.

Lianas, all parts drying dark; stems sericeous or becoming glabrate, the tri- chomes golden brown, T-shaped, sessile, ca. 0.2 mm long, straight and appressed. Leaves opposite, sericeous, eglandular, elliptic ovate or rounded, acuminate at the apex, obtuse or rounded at the base, 11.0-17.5 cm long, 6.5-11.5 cm wide, sometimes with a few large sunken glands in the lower ?3 of the blade, sparsely and inconspicuously appressed-pubescent, soon glabrate, the midrib densely pu- bescent above, prominently sunken, primary lateral veins 5 or 6 on each side, arcuate-ascending; petioles 1.0-1.7 cm long; stipules triangular, 0.5 mm long. Inflorescences terminal and upper axillary, cymose-paniculate, the branches usually to 7 per node, densely rufous tomentose, the trichomes appressed to patulous, the distal nodes with leaflike bracts 6-17 mm long, these sericeous, prominently 2-4-glandular; flowers in 4-flowered umbels or 6-flowered corymbs; floral bracts 2-4(-6) mm long, ovate or elliptic, eglandular; peduncles 1.0-3.5 mm long; pedicels 2-4 mm long. Flowers with sepals 5, 2.5-3.0 mm long, narrowly ovate, obtuse and revolute at the apex, tomentose outside, glabrous within, the anterior sepal eglandular, the 4 lateral sepals each with 1 large gland, these 1.5 mm long; petals 5, clawed, greenish-yellow, sericeous, glabrous towards the mar- gin, the 4 lateral petals with the limb 3.0-4.5 mm long, 2.5-4.0 mm wide, rounded to broadly obovate, concave, rounded to weakly hastate at the base, the margin erose and usually eglandular, posterior petal erect, the limb 2.5-2.8 mm long, 1.5-2.5 mm wide, elliptic or obovate, the margin glandular; stamens 10, the fil- aments glabrous, connate at the base, to ca. 1 mm high, 1.8-2.5 mm long, slightly unequal, the anthers subequal, to 1 mm long, glabrous; ovary globular, 1.5 mm high, tomentose, each of the 3 carpels several-sulcate, the styles 3, 2 mm long, equalling or slightly exceeding the anthers, glabrous or pubescent, subequal, the anterior style inclined toward the posterior petal, the 2 posterior styles arcuate- ascending. Fruits of 3 samaras or 1 or 2 by abortion, 2.0-2.5 cm long, 5-6 cm wide, sparsely appressed-pubescent throughout; samaras with the lateral wings broadly ovate, confluent at the base, 2.5-4.0 cm long, 2.5-3.5 cm wide, rounded at the apex, the veins conspicuous, the dorsal wing 2.0-2.7 cm wide, 1.0-1.3 cm high, semicircular; seed pyriform, ca. 1 cm long.

Erect shrub 1-2 m tall or tree to 8 m tall., young branches green or sometimes reddish, strigillose. Leaves membranaceous to subchartaceous, elliptic to elliptic- lanceolate, acuminate at apex, acute at base, (2.5-)4.5-9(-1 1) cm long, (2-)2.5- 3.5(-4.5) cm wide, upon drying appearing somewhat crinkled or puckered above; petioles slender or somewhat swollen, somewhat strigillose like the young branch- es or glabrous, 1.5-2.5(-4) mm long; stipules free, reddish, strigillose or glabrous, linear-lanceolate-, (1-)1.5(-2) mm long. Inflorescence erect, green, rarely reddish, pedunculate, 4-6-flowered umbel-like panicle (1.5-)2-3(-3.5) cm long, the com- mon peduncle minutely strigillose, 3-12(-18) mm long; flowering peduncles usu- ally glabrous, (2-)4-6(-8) mm long, bracts ca. 1.5 mm long; bracteoles ca. 1 mm long, pedicels glabrous, (7-)8-11(-12) mm long, about 2 times as long as the flowering peduncles, small T-shaped bristles at the tip, forming a collar below the sepals. Flowers ca. 1.5 cm diam.; buds 3.5-4 mm diam., unkeeled; sepals strigil- lose, glands 6, 1.5-2.5(-3) mm long, 2/33/4 as long as the sepals, posterior glands usually larger than the others; posterior petal ca. 9 mm long, lateral petals ca. 8 mm long, anterior petals ca. 6.5 mm long; androecium zygomorphic; filaments ca. 2-3 mm long, lateral filaments obviously longer and thicker than the others, curved inwards over the styles at anthesis, lateral anthers oblong, ca. 1.5 mm long, larger than the others; pollination gap ca. 1 mm long; gynoecium zygomor- phic; styles slightly uncinate at apex, lateral styles ca. 2 mm long, obviously longer and thicker than the anterior, curved inwards at anthesis, anterior style straight, thin; ovary obviously 3-lobed, carpels free at upper half. Fruit 1.5-2 cm long; carpels usually free from each other for most of their length; pyrenes oblong, (12-)15(-18) mm long, (7-)8-10(-12) mm wide, prominently winged; lateral and dorsal wings entire, sharp, (2-)3-5 mm wide, dorsal wing more prolonged at the apex than the lateral ones and free from them, all wings rounded at apex; inter- mediate wings present, short, thick tuberculate.

Erect shrub 1-2(-5) m tall, rarely a climber; young branches reddish to violet, glabrous or essentially so. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic to elliptic-oblong, acu- minate to cuspidate at apex, acute at base, (9-)10-17(-20) cm long, (2-)3-6.5 (-10) cm wide, smooth or sometimes upon drying somewhat crinkled or puckered above, midvein very prominent; petioles robust, glabrous or nearly so, (2.5-)3- 4(-5) mm long; stipules usually united, appearing as one, dark red or black, strigillose, linear-lanceolate, 2-3(-4) mm long. Inflorescence a (4-)10-30(-50)- flowered, lax, raceme-like panicle; somewhat strigillose at least when young, flowering axis, common peduncle and rachis (1-)2.5-6 cm long; common pedun- cle robust, (1-)1.5-2.5(-4) cm long, bibracteolate near the middle; rachis (0.5-)1- 2(-2.5) cm long; flowering peduncles 2-4(-5) mm long; bracts 1.5-2.5(-3.5) mm long; bracteoles (0.5-)1(-1.5) mm long; pedicel (5-)7-11 mm long, 2-3 times as long as the flowering peduncles. Flowers 1-1.5 cm diam.; buds 3-5 mm diam., keeled, keels ca. 0.5-0.7 mm wide, decurrent at the apex; sepals glabrous, glands 6, 2-3(-4) mm long, as long as or slightly shorter than the sepals; posterior petal (6-)6.5-8(-8.5) mm long, lateral petals 6-7 mm long, anterior petals 4.5-6 mm long; filaments (2-)2.5-3(-3.5) mm long, lateral filaments straight or somewhat curved inwards, obviously thicker than the others, shorter or longer than those opposite the sepals; anthers ca. 1 mm long, pollination gap ca. 1 mm long; ovary obviously 3-lobed; the styles uncinate at the apex, lateral styles 2-4.5 mm long, obviously thicker and usually 0.5 mm longer than the anterior, curved inwards at anthesis, the anterior styles straight or nearly so. Fruit pyramidal-globose, 1- 1.2 mm diam.; pyrenes ovoid, 7-10 mm long, 5-7 mm wide; dorsal wing sharp, entire, 1-2 mm wide, lateral wings thick and tuberculate or none, intermediate wings absent.

Lianas; stems brown, glabrous or nearly so even from the earliest stages, conspicuously lenticellate. Leaves opposite, membranaceous, elliptic to oblong- elliptic, abruptly to gradually acuminate at the apex, acute to obtuse at the base, 5.5-13.0 cm long, 2.0-5.5 cm wide, glabrous above, densely whitish-sericeous beneath, eglandular or sparsely and obscurely glandular along the midrib on the upper surface, the margin entire, scarcely or not at all revolute, eglandular, the midrib flat to weakly sunken, the primary lateral veins 4-6 pairs, markedly ar- cuate-ascending at ca. 50 degree angle, the reticulate veins scarcely or not at all prominulous; petioles canaliculate, sericeous, 5-9 mm long. Inflorescences ax- illary, shorter than the leaves, the flowers in cymes of 2 or 3, arranged in small panicles less than 2 cm long, of 1-2 short, usually trifurcate, branching divisions; axes and branches sericeous; bracts narrowly lanceolate, 2-3 mm long, sericeous

outside, glabrous within except near the base, sometimes with a pair of sessile, plate-shaped glands; peduncles 1.5-4.0 mm long, these with a pair of ovate brac- teoles at the apex, the bracteoles pubescent outside near the base, glabrous with- in; pedicels 11-13 mm long in fruit, slender; pedicels and peduncles sericeous. Flowers with the sepals ovate to ovate-oblong, rounded at the apex, ca. 2 mm long, sericeous except near the margins, 1 sepal eglandular, the others bearing a total of 7 or 8 oblong, glabrous glands ca. 1.5 mm long; petals not seen; stamens to ca. 2 mm long, the filaments glabrous, flattened, the anthers oblong, ca. 0.9 mm long; ovary densely pubescent, the styles glabrous, ca. 2.5 mm long, truncate at the apex with the inner angle obtuse, the outer margin narrowly pointed. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, pale brown, the lateral wings flabellate, weakly sinuate on the outer margin, 10-15 mm long, 7-11 mm wide, the dorsal wing absent; seminiferous area oblong, 3-6 mm long, 1-2 mm diam., villous to sericeous, the surface not at all visible.

Lianas, growing into canopy to ca. 30 m; stems glabrescent. Leaves opposite, ovate to oblong-ovate or ovate-elliptic, acuminate to cuspidate at the apex, round- ed at the base, 5.5-20.0 cm long, 3-10 cm wide, glabrous, subcoriaceous, the margin weakly revolute; petioles 7-15 mm long, canaliculate, biglandular between the middle and the apex, the glands thick, subglobular, 2-3 mm broad. Inflores- cences axillary and terminal, shorter than the leaves, of racemes in panicles to 25 cm long; bracteoles paired at the nodes of the inflorescence, 2-12 mm long, the larger ones near the base often toothed, 1 of each pair with a large gland; axis and branches of inflorescence and pedicels moderately pubescent and some- what ferruginous with short T-shaped trichomes, axis and branches flattened; pedicels 2-4 mm long, enlarged at the apex, appearing articulate just below the flower; peduncles 5-12 mm long with 2 small bracteoles and a large sessile gland at the apex. Flowers 18 mm diam.; sepals orbicular, 1.5-3.0 mm long, oblique on the pedicel, curved inward against the stamens, the lateral margins ciliate, turned outward, glands 9, most sepals with 2 irregular greenish glands 1.5-2.0 mm long; petals 5, clawed, subovate to obovate, 4 of them yellow, rounded at the apex, undulate and rounded to truncate at the base, 8-10 mm long, entire, the fifth petal orange, at least on the margin, minutely undulate and fimbriate, 11-13 mm long, to 7 mm wide, usually held somewhat erect and higher than the entire petals; stamens 10, glabrous, spreading, unequal, curved, 3 directed toward the orange petal between 2 of the styles, the longest to 4 mm long, the anthers nearly as broad as long; ovary 3-parted, each part with 3 ribs, densely pubescent, the ovary hirsute; styles 3, somewhat spreading, to ca. 4 mm long, the apex subspatulate, the inner angle protruding, obtuse, stigmatic, the dorsal angle apiculate or fre- quently uncinate. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras; dorsal wings small, to ca. 5 mm long, the lateral wings membranaceous, broadly fan shaped, 1.8-2.5 cm long, 1.7-3.5 cm wide, the dorsal wing to 5 mm high, glabrate, the body 4-6 mm wide, suborbicular-conoid, sparsely appressed-pubescent with short, T-shaped tri- chomes.

Lianas; stems glabrous or nearly so. Leaves opposite, elliptic-ovate, acumi- nate and down-turned at the apex, usually obtuse at the base, rounded elsewhere, 7-23 cm long, 3.0-11.5 cm wide, glabrous, subcoriaceous, entire or somewhat glandular-denticulate toward the apex, glands lacking at the base of the blade; petioles 9-20 mm long, canaliculate, biglandular between the middle and the apex, the glands drying thick, subglobular, 1.5-2.0 mm diam. Inflorescences axillary or terminal, shorter than the subtending leaves, of 10-14-flowered racemes in corymbose panicles; axis and branches flattened, sparsely to densely ferruginous- puberulous; bracts lanceolate, puberulous, 3-5 mm long; peduncles 6-11 mm long, thick, the bracteoles apical, ovate, 1.0-1.5 mm long, 1 glandular; pedicels 2-4 mm long, thickened, puberulous. Flowers 18 mm diam.; sepals suborbicular or elliptic, 2.0-2.5 mm long, sericeous-pubescent, glandular, the glands 10, ellip- soid, 2-3 mm long; petals thickly membranaceous, subovate to suborbicular, clawed, 5-6 mm long, the 4 lateral petals yellow, the margin entire, the interior petal orange, the margin fimbriate; stamens 10, glabrous; style thick, glabrous or nearly so, the ovary villous, somewhat curved-divergent, 4-5 mm long, the apex subspatulate with the internal angle protuberant, obtuse and stigmatic, the outer part apiculate or uncinate. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, the lateral wings suberose-coriaceous, trapezoidal, sericeous when young, glabrous in age, 5-7 mm long, 10-13 mm wide, the dorsal wing coriaceous, 1-2 mm high, the semi- niferous area 8 mm long, smooth, weakly appressed-pubescent when young, gla- brescent.

Lianas, the stems whitish-sericeous, the lenticels soon showing through the pubescence. Leaves opposite, subcoriaceous, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, obtuse and cuspidate at the apex, usually rounded at the base, sometimes broadly acute, 5-12 cm long, 2.3-5.5 cm wide, glabrous above, densely ochroleucous-sericeous beneath, sparsely glandular along the midrib on the upper surface, the margin weakly revolute and glandular dentate, sometimes with large, thick glandular depressions, primary lateral veins 5 or 6 pairs, markedly arcuate-ascending at ca. 50 degree angle, the midrib drying sunken, reddish above, the reticulate veins weakly prominulous; petioles 6-10 mm long, canaliculate, sericeous, usually bearing a pair of thick, globular glands between the lower 1/3 and the middle. Inflorescences terminal and upper axillary, of racemes disposed in panicles; axes and branches slightly flattened, brownish, sericeous to tomentose, the nodes thickened; bracts lanceolate, to ca. 5 mm long, bearing a pair of large glands in the lower 1/3, these ca. 1 mm diam., truncate and broadest at the apex; peduncles 2.0-2.5 mm long, subtended by a bract at the base, bibracteolate at the apex, the

bracteoles ovate-triangular, 1.0-1.5 mm long, sericeous, at least medially on the abaxial surface, usually glabrous adaxially; pedicels 4.5-6.0 mm long in fruit, sericeous-tomentose; sepals oblong-ovate, 3.0-3.5 mm long, ca. 1.5 mm diam., appressed-pubescent at the base outside, otherwise glabrous, 4 sepals bearing 2 glands each, these oblong, thick, ca. 2 mm long; petals and other flower parts not seen. Fruit a schizocarp of 3 samaras, light yellowish-green, the lateral wings flabellate, acutely and deeply dentate on the outer margin, 15-23 mm long, 8-13 mm wide, cinereous appressed-pubescent throughout, the viscidulous surface showing through the pubescence, the nervation radial; dorsal wing 1-3 mm long; seminiferous area ellipsoid, 4.0-5.5 mm long, ca. 3 mm diam., weakly pubescent to glabrate, the weakly viscidulous surface usually visible.

Liana. Leaves opposite, papyraceous, ovate-lanceolate, acuminate at apex, rounded at the base, 4-13 cm long, 2-6 cm wide, the margin entire, narrowly revolute, glabrous on the upper surface except for the midrib, the secondary veins slightly conspicuous, the reticulate veins prominulous; lower surface with scattered appressed trichomes and more numerous patulous trichomes, the pri- mary lateral veins of 4-5 pairs, ascending, the reticulate veins more or less prom- inent; glands at the base of the blade lacking but sometimes with small scattered glands. Inflorescence large, a terminal thyrsoid panicle; branches ferruginous or red, tomentose, bracts narrowly lanceolate, pubescent, 1-2 mm long; peduncles 1-3 mm long, hirsute; pedicels 5-8 mm long, slender, flexuous or erect, puber- ulent, 20-35 in each dense pseudoraceme. Flowers 12 mm diameter; sepals ovate, broadly obtuse, purplish, villous with the margin glabrescent; petals violet, mem- branaceous, glabrous, the blade rounded-obovate, entire, 5 mm long, 4 mm wide, the claw 1 mm long; filaments glabrous, 2 of them thicker; styles thick, 2 curved at the base, glabrous, spatulate at the apex with the internal angle protrudent, obtuse and stigmatic, the external angle somewhat acute, the ovary hirsute. Sa- mara shaped like a butterfly, the lateral wings flabellate, subhyaline, 8-12 mm long, 15-22 mm wide, membranaceous, venous-reticulate, softly pubescent, the outer margin crenate, the dorsal crest 1-2 mm high.

Liana, the young branches angular, densely reddish-brown, appressed puber- ulent. Leaves opposite, coriaceous, stiff, ovate or elliptic, short-acuminate, ob- tuse to subrounded at the base, glabrous except for the midrib adaxially, scattered puberulous beneath with short-stalked, appressed T-shaped trichomes, 9-12(-21)  cm long, 4.0-6.5(-8.5) cm wide, primary lateral veins 3-6 on each side; petioles 1.2-2.0 cm long, minutely pubescent, biglandular at the apex. Inflorescence ax- illary or terminal, cymose-paniculate, branching with umbels of 3 or 4 flowers; axis and branches densely reddish-brown villous-pilose with thick reddish, sub- appressed trichomes, angular and somewhat flattened; peduncles of each umbel thickened, angular, 5-10 mm long; basal bracts 2, oblong, 3-4 mm long, amplex- icaul glandular; individual floral peduncles stiff, terete, 10-14 mm long, appressed rufous villous, supporting an obsolete 0.5 mm long pedicel and a pair of floral bracts at the apex, these 2 bracts obovate-orbicular, subcoriaceous, concave, ca. 1 cm long and 1.2 cm wide, appressed rufous pubescent, enveloping each flower bud. Flowers with sepals 4, oblong, obtuse, ca. 4(-7) mm long, ca. 2 mm wide, densely reddish-brown villous outside, reddish and glabrous inside, sepals each with 2 large, elliptic-oblong glands, 2.5-3.0 mm long; petals yellow, the limb obovate, cuneate at base, 8-10 mm long and wide, the margin erose, the claw thick, ca. 2 mm long; stamens slightly unequal, the filaments flattened, 2.5-3.0 mm long, glabrous; anthers 1.5 mm long, oblong, glabrous, the connective thick- ened, ellipsoid; styles thick, stiff, pilose towards the base, enlarged and truncate at the apex, 2 of them with dorsal angles elevated and acute, the third style shorter with the angle rounded; ovary villous. Fruit with the seminiferous area ovate-oblong, 12-14 mm long, ca. 8 mm wide, the ventral areole oblong, 10-11 mm long; wings 4(or 5), membranaceous, the lateral wings suborbicular, contin- uous with the base, parted at the apex, to 3 cm wide, minutely puberulous; dorsal wing semiorbicular, ca. 2 cm long, 1 cm wide; intermediate wings reduced to the posterior part, obovate-orbicular, 7-8 mm long and wide.

Tree 4 m tall, the trunk to 10 cm d.b.h., the young branches yellowish-brown appressed-sericeous with trichomes contiguous, soon glabrate, the internodes 1.5-3.0 mm long near the apex. Leaves opposite, coriaceous, clustered at the ends of the branchlets, obovate-elliptic, obtuse to acute or acuminate at the apex, narrowly cuneate at the base, (3.5-)4.5-6.5 cm long, (1.1-)2.0-3.5 cm wide, en- tire, sparsely pilose to appressed-pubescent above with slender, somewhat flex- uous T-shaped trichomes, becoming glabrate, the lower surface paler, subap- pressed-villous; primary lateral veins 6 or 7 on each side, gradually curved to the margins, the reticulate veins prominent, drying paler than the surface, the surface weakly viscidulous; petioles 6-10 mm long, subterete, appressed-pubescent, stip- ules 2-3 mm long, axillary, coalesced to petiole ca. 2/3 of their length, triangular, acute to narrowly rounded at the apex, densely subappressed villose. Cymes axillary to leaf scars, shorter than the leaves; flowers ca. 14 mm in diameter; pedicels 15-20 mm long, drying ca. 1 mm in diam., rigid, densely subappressed villous; bracts oblong-triangular, ca. 2 mm long, acute at the apex, villose outside, glabrous within; calyx 10 mm in diam., the sepals triangular or ovate, 4-5 mm long, 3.0-3.5 mm wide, subappressed-sericeous, the calycine glands thick, ob- long-elliptic, 2-3 mm long, 1 mm in diam., well spaced or sometimes close; petals white, 7-8 mm long, 5.0-5.5 mm wide, the limb thick, obovate, rounded and entire at the apex, narrowed and weakly incised dentate below to lyrate, glabrous adaxially, villous along the midrib abaxially at least in the lower 1/3, the claw thick, ca. 1.5 mm long, barbate at the base, densely sericeous on the lower side; stamens 10, shorter than the sepals, the filaments thickened, flattened, 2.5-3.2 mm long, subulate towards the apex, shortly triangular-dilated at the base, the basal 1/4 hirsute-barbate, the trichomes to 1 mm long; anthers ellipsoid, ca. 1.5 mm long, the connective thickened, protruded apically, the lateral wings of the thecae papillate, 0.3 mm wide. Fruits tricoccoid, 3-lobed, the cocci monosper- mous, indehiscent, subglobose, cartilaginous, rounded on the outside, obtusely triangular on inside, 3.5 mm in diam., densely reddish brown-hirsute, the scar ca. 2 mm in diam., the styles free, subulate, affixed adaxially to the base of the carpel; seed globose, the integument membranaceous; cotyledons contorted, con- volutely spiraled inward, torus flat, hirsute.

Trees, ca. 16 m tall, thinly white sericeous when young, soon glabrate. Leaves opposite, subcoriaceous, mostly clustered near the ends of the branches, elliptic, abruptly and obtusely acuminate at the apex, rounded to attenuate at the base, 15-21 cm long, 4.5-10.5 cm wide, drying reddish-brown, glabrous or nearly so above, the midrib sunken, glabrous below except sparsely appressed-pubescent on the midrib, with a few oval or less frequently rounded, sunken, dark, opaque glands scattered over the surface but especially in the lower 1/2 of the blade along the margin and near the midrib; primary lateral veins 9-11 pairs, moderately straight to the middle, then curved upward and loosely connected, the tertiary veins prominulous, the margins strongly revolute; petioles densely appressed- pubescent, 1.5-2.5 cm long; stipules lanceolate, ca. 6 mm long, bilobed at the apex, clasping the petiole at the base, fused to the petiole and remaining with it when the leaves fall, densely appressed-pubescent outside, glabrous within. In- florescences terminal at the ends of short branches on the older stems, ca. 20 cm long; axes and peduncles densely ferruginous, appressed-pubescent with T-shaped trichomes; peduncles shortly branched, ferruginous-tomentose, each bearing 2 flowers; bracts narrowly ovate, acute to acuminate, 1.5-2.0 mm long, weakly clasping at the base, pubescent outside, glabrous inside, ciliate; pedicels 4-6 mm long, appressed pubescent; bracteoles alternate, minute, narrowly ovate, with stalked axillary glands 1-2 mm long, the stalk flattened, pubescent, the gland disc shaped, 1.0-1.5 mm diam. Flowers with the sepals 3.5-6.0 mm long (in fruit), ovate-oblong, rounded at the apex, verrucose and pubescent outside, glabrous and smooth within, glandular, the glands 10, oblong, ca. 2 mm long, the apical portion somewhat narrower, turned weakly outward; petals not seen; stamens persisting with fruits ca. 2 mm long, somewhat flattened, pubescent at the base, the anthers ovate-oblong, 0.7 mm long; ovary bicarpellate, bilocular, the styles 2. Fruits bicoccoid, bilobed, the cocci ellipsoid, ca. 5 mm long (dried), blackish on drying, shiny, joined to each other for only about 2/3 of their width on the inner side.

Trees, to 16 m tall and 12 cm d.b.h.; stems densely ferruginous-sericeous or ferruginous-tomentose when young, soon glabrous, the leaf scars conspicuous. Leaves opposite, thin, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, mostly rounded and abruptly acuminate at the apex, sometimes gradually acuminate, attenuate at the base, 9.0-14.5 cm long, 3.0-8.5 cm wide, glabrous above except for a few scattered trichomes on the midrib and the surface, drying shiny above, glabrous and shiny below except relatively densely appressed-pubescent on the midrib, the midrib drying almost flat above, raised beneath; primary lateral veins 7-9 pairs, directed almost straight toward the margins, becoming ramified and loop-connected before the margin, beneath drying scarcely more conspicuous than the prominulous ter- tiary veins, the margins often weakly revolute; petioles 1.5-2.0 cm long, densely pubescent like the stems, eglandular. Inflorescences spiciform, axillary, pendent, the axis stout, to more than 30 cm long, the branches short, ca. 1 cm long, the axes, branches, and peduncles densely ferruginous-tomentose; bracts small, ovate, eglandular; peduncles 3-4 mm long; pedicels 5-8 mm long; bracteoles minute with a stalked axillary gland, the gland ca. 1 mm long, the stalk flattened but thickened medially, sparsely pubescent, the gland discoid, ca. 5 mm wide. Flowers to 1.5 cm diam.; sepals glandular, oblong-ellipsoid, rounded at the apex, sparsely pubescent, the glands 8 or 9, oblong or oval, 2.5-4.0 mm long; petals pink, clawed, orbicular or obovate, 3-4 mm long, the claw 2.0-3.5 mm long; stamens 10, the filaments connate basally. Fruits not seen.

Slender trees, to 10 m tall; sap often somewhat milky; young stems, petioles, inflorescence branches, and midrib of leaf strigose with ferruginous, T-shaped trichomes. Leaves opposite, ovate-elliptic to oblanceolate, long-acuminate, rounded or shortly. cuneate at the base, 4-18 cm long, 1.5-6.0 cm wide, glabrate except for the midrib above and below, with several round glands below, usually 1 on each side of the midrib below and others sometimes scattered throughout the blade, the margin entire, pubescent, revolute in age; petioles 6-9 mm long; stipules connate, minute, ovate, axillary. Inflorescences of long, pendent, axillary racemes 10-20 cm long, longer than the leaves, the axes and peduncles sparsely  ferruginous-pubescent with appressed, T-shaped trichomes; axis slender, flex- uous; bracts ovate-oblong, acute, ca. 1.5 mm long, united to the peduncle at the base; pedicel 1-flowered, 2-5 mm long, bearing 2 small bracts midway and 5 inconspicuous glandular appendages at the apex; peduncle 5-10 mm long, pink. Flowers 8 mm diam.; calyx 8-glandular, the sepals oblong-elliptic, ca. 2.5 mm long, thickened toward the apex, puberulent or glabrescent, acute to rounded and reflexed at the apex, ciliate, the glands white, prominent, 2.5-3.0 mm long, nar- rowed and curved outward at the apex; petals clawed, magenta, obovate, ca. 4 mm long, ciliate, spreading, the base attenuate, the margins weakly denticulate, the claw thick, 1.0-1.5 mm long; stamens 10, ca. 2 mm long, shorter than the sepals, subequal, the anthers elliptic-oblong, glabrous, ca. 1 mm long, the fila- ments ca. 1 mm long, hirsute at the base; pistil 2-parted, each ovary with a slender, persistent, divergent style, longer than the ovary, the apex truncate, thickened, held at about the level of the anther. Fruit a coriaceous schizocarp of 2 separable, 1-seeded carpels, each carpel indehiscent, ovoid, 3.5-5.0 mm long and ca. 2 mm wide, with a thin fleshy red covering at maturity; seeds hemi- spheroid, tan, smooth, ca. 4 mm long.

Liana, younger stems densely appressed-pubescent, the trichomes T-shaped, mostly type A, in part type B, with free ends straight but somewhat patulous, becoming glabrous in age. Leaves opposite or subopposite, ovate to suborbicular, abruptly to gradually acuminate at apex, also often apiculate, rounded to cordate at base, 4-13 cm long, 3-10 cm wide, palmiveined at base with the lowermost lateral veins usually joining before reaching the midrib, with 3 or 4 pairs of lateral veins above the base, these arcuate-ascending, drying dark, the upper surface nearly glabrous, the reticulate venation obscure, the lower surface densely lanugi- nous with 2 types of T-shaped trichomes, both sessile and stalked (type A and type B), the free ends curved and twisted mostly patulous; margins entire with a few, widely spaced, conspicuous glands; petioles 2-6(10) cm long, moderately appressed-pubescent, flexuose, biglandular at apex. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, of branched 10-15-flowered umbels; branches, peduncles, pedicels and calyces densely appressed-pubescent; peduncles 2-7 mm long, bibracteate at the apex; pedicels 5-8 mm long. Flowers to ca. 2 cm diam.; sepals ovate, obtuse, ca. 2 mm long, nearly glabrous along the outside margin, the glands swollen, oblong-elliptic, to 1.6 mm long at anthesis; petals yellow, broadly obovate, clawed, 8-12 mm long, often unequal, glabrous, the margins denticulate; stamens glabrous, unequal, 2.5-3.5 mm long, the filaments flattened toward the base, united near the base, the anthers unequal, the connectives thickened; ovary and base of styles hirsute; the styles petaloid and hooded at apex, ca. 5 mm long to fold of hood, the petaloid part to 2 mm long, 1.5-2 mm wide. Fruit a schizocarp of 1-3 samaras, each 3.5-4.0 cm long, densely pubescent on the body, sparsely pubescent on the wing, the body with 1 or 2 projections or reduced wings on each side; the wing membranaceous, gibbous along the dorsal margin (sometimes also on ventral margin), slightly broader toward apex.

Vine; lower leaf surface, petioles, branches, peduncles, pedicels and sepals densely sericeous (trichomes type A). Leaves opposite, broadly ovate or oblong- ovate, acuminate or acute at apex, rounded to truncate or subcordate at base, 8- 13(-15) cm long, 5-9(-10) cm wide, glabrous except for midrib above, densely sericeous below (trichomes types A and B), mostly eglandular, entire or irregu- larly crenate, the lateral veins 7 or 8 pairs, prominently ascending, the tertiary venation weakly prominulous; petioles 1-7 cm long, with 2 sessile, lateral glands at apex. Inflorescence of terminal or axillary, simple or branched, pedunculate pseudo-umbels of 10-16 flowers; pedicels inconspicuously pedunculate, 5-8 mm long; peduncle bibracteolate, 2-4 mm long. Flowers showy; sepals oblong-ovate, villous except at apex, turned inward above, the margin ciliate; all but 1 sepal glandular, the glands 2 mm long; petals orbicular, clawed, glabrous, at least the outer margin denticulate, the 2 petals on either side of the eglandular sepal larger, to 9 mm diam., concave, yellow or with orange on center below; 3 petals reduced, orange to red, the middle one often held higher, its claws thicker, erect; stamens unequal, 6 long with anthers covered at least in part by the flap-like apices of the styles, the anthers with the connective enlarged, introrsely dehiscent; pollen tacky; styles 3, glabrous except at base, with an apical flap, that of the style opposite the eglandular sepal concave. Schizocarp of 3 samaras; samaras 2-4 mm long, pubescent on body and along thickened ventral margin of wing, the wing dorsal, 3-5 mm wide at base, enlarged to 1 cm wide at apex; body angular- tuberculate.

Liana, the younger stems densely hirsute, the pubescence usually apparently simple, stiff, translucent, more than 1 mm long, the longer trichomes often un- derlain with much shorter bifurcated trichomes. Leaves stiffly coriaceous, ovate or ovate-elliptic, abruptly acuminate at the apex, weakly cordate at the base, (7-) 20-23 cm long, (4.7-)11-14 cm wide, usually broadest near the middle, gla- brous above except sometimes weakly pubescent on the midrib in the lower 1/2 of the blade, sparsely pubescent throughout, below with erect bifurcate tri- chomes, much denser on the midrib, the trichomes chiefly bifurcate with one branch mostly longer than the other; major veins 6-10 pairs, moderately straight to curved, weakly loop connected; petioles 4-10 mm long, densely pubescent like the branchlets. Panicles terminal or in upper axils, the branches densely hirsute like the stems. Flowers not seen; fruiting peduncles 1.5-2.0 mm long, the pedicel articulation swollen, the pedicels 4-6 mm long, the bracteoles ovate, concave, hirsute to strigose abaxially, glabrous adaxially, peduncles and pedicels densely hirsute; calyx ovate, glabrous, rounded at the apex, ca. 2.3 mm long, the calycine glands oblong, ca. 3 mm long; ovary densely whitish hirsute-velutinous, the styles glabrous, ca. 1.6 mm long, dilated at the apex. Samaras pale brown, densely pubescent with sessile to stalked, patulous, T-shaped trichomes; lateral wings rigidly subcoriaceous, the superior wing oblong-obovate, 21-37 mm long, 10-17 mm wide, asymmetrically obtuse at the apex, scarcely or not at all confluent with the inferior wing, the latter 7-14 mm long, 5-7 mm wide, ovate to elliptic, con- stricted at the base, rounded at the apex; dorsal wing 2-8 mm high, suborbicular; seed ovoid, ca. 7 mm long, central areole 2.6-3.0 mm in diameter.

Liana, or rarely a shrub, the stems slender, tomentose when young with sessile and stalked T-shaped trichomes, the patulous trichomes falling free leaving a residue of appressed, T-shaped trichomes; stem surface ultimately glabrous in part; trichomes with lateral branches flattened. Leaves moderately thick, oblong- elliptic to broadly ovate, abruptly acuminate to bluntly acute at the apex, rarely almost rounded, obtuse to truncate or rounded at the base, (4.5-)8-13(-15) cm long, (2.5-)5-8(-10) cm wide, appressed-pubescent when young, adult blades glabrous above, glabrous beneath except densely appressed- or patulous-pubes- cent on major veins, sometimes weakly pubescent on surface near the vein axils; major lateral veins in 4-6 pairs; petioles (4-)10-15(-22) mm long, narrowly can- aliculate, appressed-pubescent. Panicles terminal or upper axillary, dichoto- mously branched, densely tomentose, 15-30 cm long; bracts conspicuous, per- sistent, broadly reniform to suborbicular, long petiolate, 1.0-1.5 mm long, 1.1- 1.7 mm wide, gray to pink, densely appressed- or patulous-pubescent. Flowers 13-17 mm broad, umbellate; peduncles 2-4 mm long; pedicels 2-5 mm long; sepals ovate, blunt at the apex, sericeous to tomentose, the calyx glands 8, 2.5- 4.0 mm long; petals yellow turning orange, red, or salmon in age, sometimes only at the center of the blade, prominently clawed, the blade almost rounded, ca. 7 mm wide, the margin dentate to lacerate-dentate; anthers ca. 1.5 mm long; styles ca. 2 mm long. Samaras stramineous, persistently sericeous-tomentose, the pu- bescence most dense near the base and on the seminiferous area; wings moder- ately thick, the superior wing oblong, rounded to nearly truncate at the apex, 3.5-5.5 cm long, 10-14 mm wide, not at all confluent with the inferior wing, the latter 6-15 mm long, 3-6 mm wide, the dorsal crest 2-3 mm high, appendages lacking between the dorsal and lateral wings; body 8-9 mm in diam., densely tomentose.

Liana or scandent shrub, the stems slender, sparsely pubescent with T-shaped trichomes when young, soon glabrous, bearing interpetiolar ridges at least when young. Leaves thin, elliptic to oblong-elliptic or ovate-elliptic, shortly acuminate to acute at the apex the acumen downturned, mostly acute to obtuse, or some- times rounded at the base, 5.5-13.0(-16.0) cm long, 2-7 cm wide, glabrous above, glabrous beneath except the midrib at least sometimes sericeous when young, both surfaces with scattered glands, less than 0.5 mm in diam.; major lateral veins 4-7 per side; petioles 5-11 mm long, glabrous. Panicles terminal and upper ax- illary, usually exceeding the leaves; branches, peduncles, and pedicels sericeous, soon glabrate; bracts inconspicuous, oval to elliptic, appressed-pubescent, es- pecially near the base, 5-20 mm long; peduncles 2-5 mm long; pedicels slender, 2-5 mm long; sepals narrowly ovate, obtuse, 2.5-3.0 mm long, glabrous except for ciliate margin. Flowers with the calycine glands thick, shiny, 2.0-2.5 mm long; petals clawed, yellow, probably turning orange in age, glabrous, the blade obovate to oblong-elliptic, sagittate at the base, 4.0-5.5 mm long, 2.6-4.0 mm wide, the margin entire, the medial vein thickened toward the base, the claw thick, 1.5-2.0 mm long; anthers elliptic, glabrous, 1.0-1.2 mm long; styles held ca. 1.5 mm above the sepals, slightly longer than the stamens. Samaras stramin- eous to brown, glabrous or nearly so, the wings thin but rigid, the veins often conspicuous, the superior wing narrowly spatulate, 15-30 mm long, 6-10 mm wide, the inferior wing ovate to obovate or rarely spatulate-oblong, 6-9 mm long, 4-6 mm wide, the adjacent margins of the superior and inferior wings confluent and continuous at the base, the dorsal wing semi-orbicular, rigid, 2-4 mm high, the appendages usually lacking between dorsal and lateral wings; body glabrous, ca. 6 mm diam.

Liana, the branches appressed ferruginous-pubescent, becoming eventually glabrous. Leaves opposite, coriaceous, lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate or oblong- lanceolate, acute to acuminate at apex, obtuse to acute at base, 5-13 cm long, 2- 5.5 cm wide, glabrous and shiny above, glabrous or sometimes minutely ap- pressed-pubescent below, minutely and obscurely glandular, usually also with 1 or 2 pairs of plate-shaped glands along the midrib near the base; primary lateral veins 6-9 pairs; petioles 5-10 mm long, eglandular, appressed-pubescent, gla- brous in age; stipules interpetiolar, deciduous. Inflorescence terminal, cymose- paniculate, equalling the uppermost leaves, the axis and branches angular, ap- pressed, ferruginous-pubescent. Flowers 1.8-2 cm diam., often 4-umbellate, bracts ovate, obtuse at apex, ca. 1.5 mm long; peduncle thickened, 3-5 mm long, densely appressed-pubescent; pedicels 2-4 mm long; bracteoles paired, opposite, clasping, ovate, subacute, ca. 1 mm long; sepals 2-2.5 mm long, rounded at the apex, glabrous or subglabrous, densely ciliate; calyx glands 8, oblong, ca. 3 mm long; petals yellow, glabrous, the limb suborbicular or ovate-orbicular, 5.5-8 mm long, emarginate at base, the margin denticulate, the claw thick, 1.5-2.5 mm long; stamens somewhat unequal, united at the base into a tube, villous outside at the base, 1.5-2 mm long; anthers oblong-ellipsoid, ca. 1.5 mm long, the connective glabrous, thickened dorsally; ovary hirsute; style glabrous, broadly flattened sub- apically, recurved at apex. Samara with vestigial wings, ovate, rugose, drying 6-11 mm long, sparsely to densely subappressed pubescent, the lateral wings reduced, 2-8 mm long, deltoid and rounded at apex, the dorsal wing about equal to lateral wings but forming a sharp crest on the fruit body; inferior wings lacking altogether, the body ca. 8 mm diam.

Liana, stems slender, subsericeous when young, sparsely appressed pubes- cent to glabrate in age, lacking lenticels; trichomes metacentric, sessile. Leaves moderately thick, oblong-elliptic, gradually to abruptly acuminate, usually obtuse at the base, sometimes acute or subrounded, 6.5-18.5 cm long, 2.6-7.0 cm wide, drying yellowish green, glabrous on upper surface, sparsely appressed-pubescent on lower surface, denser on the veins, major veins 4 or 5 pairs, prominently ascending, the upper surface semiglossy, the reticulate venation prominulous on drying, the lower surface almost matte on drying, the reticulate venation less conspicuous than on the upper surface; petioles canaliculate, 1.0-1.5 cm long, appressed-pubescent; stipules thick, narrowly triangular, persistent, appressed pubescent, ca. 2 mm long. Panicles terminal, less than 15 cm long; bracteoles 0.8-2.0 cm long, ovate-elliptic, glabrous above except along the midrib, densely- appressed pubescent on the lower surface; peduncles 5 mm long; pedicels 3 mm long; peduncles and pedicels densely appressed pubescent, completely obscuring the surface, both subtended by narrowly deltoid bractlets ca. 1 mm long, these sparsely appressed pubescent on the outer surface. Most flower parts not seen; anthers oblong, ca. 1.3 mm long; ovary densely pubescent, the trichomes meta- centric, whitish, both sessile and weakly stalked, obscuring the surface; styles glabrous, 2.4 mm long, truncate at the apex, the medial style bilaterally sym- metrical, the two lateral styles unilaterally flared at the apex. Samaras brown, sparsely appressed pubescent, densely so on the seminiferous area, the wings moderately thin, weakly viscidulous upon magnification, the superior wing ob- long, rounded at the apex, 3.5-3.8 cm long, 7-11 mm wide, not at all confluent with the inferior wing, the latter to 12 mm long and 5 mm wide; dorsal crest to 6 mm long, rounded to truncate at the apex, appendages lacking between the dorsal and lateral wings; body 8-9 mm broad, densely tomentose.

Liana; young stems, petioles and blades below densely to sparsely pubescent with appressed T-shaped trichomes (type A). Leaves opposite, subcoriaceous, mostly elliptic, sometimes ovate, gradually acuminate at the apex, the acumen often downturned, rounded at base, 9-16(-18) cm long, 4.5-7 cm wide, glabrous and somewhat shiny and rugulose above, the minute reticulum obvious, with the veinlets less than 1 mm apart, sparsely appressed-pubescent throughout beneath; petioles 5-10 mm long, with 1 or 2 sessile glands along each side near the apex. Inflorescences cymose-paniculate, many-flowered, much-branched, axillary or terminal, 4-15 cm long; flowers solitary or several per axil; peduncle, pedicels and sepals densely appressed-pubescent; peduncle to 3.5 cm long; pedicels ses- sile, to 5-10 mm long, to 1.5 cm long in fruit. Flowers yellow, sepals ovate, 2- 3 mm long, the glands elliptical, to 1.5 mm long, more or less contiguous; petals clawed, 4-7 mm long, yellow, glabrous, early caducous, the anterior petal often slightly larger and with a more fimbriate margin than the remaining petals; sta- mens sometimes unequal, to 2.0 mm long, glabrous, free to base, the anthers oblong, glandular; styles 3, distinct, to 2.3 mm long, glabrous except near base. Samaras 1-3, each with a single dorsal wing which is thickened along the inner side; seminiferous area ca. 8 mm long, densely pubescent, raised, with a small wing or ridge on both sides; wing 2.5-3.5 cm long, ca. 1 cm wide, short appressed pubescent especially near the body and along the dorsal margin, with an obtuse lobe ca. 1 cm high on the inner margin close to the body.

Liana; stems shiny, moderately appressed-pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves opposite, coriaceous, mostly elliptic-ovate, sometimes oblong-elliptic, mostly abruptly acuminate at the apex, obtuse to rounded or subcordate at the base, 4.5-13 cm long, 2.5-6.5 cm wide, often with a pair of large round or ellipsoid glands at the base, glabrous to sparsely pubescent with fine, flexuose trichomes on both the surfaces, entire or occasionally with minute glandular teeth, midrib prominently sunken, primary lateral veins arcuate-ascending, prominulous, sec- ondary lateral veins prominulous, with the reticulum on the upper surface ob- scure, areoles usually more than 1 mm across, petioles canaliculate, sparsely appressed-pubescent, 4-12 mm long. Inflorescences cymose-paniculate, axillary and terminal, many-flowered, the branches sparsely appressed-pubescent; brac- teoles leaf-like but narrower, with glandular teeth; terminal peduncles short, 4- 6-flowered, appressed-pubescent; pedicels slender, glabrous, 4-12 mm long. Flowers yellow; petals and sepals glabrous; sepals membranaceous, suborbicular, ca. 2 mm long, their basal glands oblong, thick, ca. 2 mm long at anthesis; petals clawed, suborbicular, shortly fimbriate with glandular teeth, to 1 cm long includ- ing claw, to 8.5 cm wide; stamens with filaments glabrous, connate basally, ca. 3 mm long, the anthers orbicular to ellipsoid, ca. 0.8 mm long, the connective thick, glandular; ovary villose, the styles 3, ca. 3.2 mm long, equal, truncate at apex. Samaras 2.5-2.8 cm long, becoming reddish, sparsely stramineous-stri- gose, rounded at the apex, the ventral margin thickened, curved outward, lateral wings lacking, the seminiferous area smooth.

Slender liana; young stems sparsely appressed pubescent with T-shaped tri- chomes, these sessile or weakly stalked with branches short and stiff or moder- ately thin, somewhat flexuous, older stems glabrous, smooth to finely lenticel- lulate. Leaves opposite, ovate-elliptic to narrowly elliptic, acuminate at the apex, acute to obtuse at the base, 4-9.5 cm long, 1.7-4.5 cm wide, usually drying dark brown, sometimes drying green at least when in flower, glabrous to sparsely strigose on both sides near the midrib, becoming glabrous, moderately stiff, the major lateral veins 5-7, arcuate-ascending and weakly loop-connected; petioles canaliculate, 5-9 mm long, strigose becoming glabrous. Inflorescences terminal or in upper axils, corymbose, the peduncles, pedicels and calyces moderately to densely strigose, the trichomes, appressed, short, brown, T-shaped; peduncles

1-13 mm long; pedicels 10-18 mm long (to 25 mm in fruit). Flowers yellow; calyx lobes biglandular, 3.3-4.0 mm long, acute to rounded at the apex, the margin sometimes glabrous, glands oblong, 2.5-3.5 mm long; petals 7-10 mm long, clawed, the blade elliptical to rounded, fimbriate marginally, the inner surface glabrous, the outer surface and claw strigose, glabrous near the margins; stamens 4-5 mm long, the filaments glabrous, the anthers ca. 1.3 mm long; style glabrous, slightly exceeding the stamens, the ovary densely reddish-brown pubescent. Sa- maras red, 4.0-5.5 cm long, sparsely strigose, the wing 3.4-4.4 cm long, char- taceous, the dorsal margin with a thin semiovate basal appendage 3-7 mm high, 6-10 mm long, becoming thickened toward the apex, moderately straight then becoming convexly curved, narrowed at the base, the broadest part 1.4-2.0 cm wide, 1.0-1.2 cm wide near the base, the seminiferous area 10-12 mm long with 5-8 conspicuous unequal transverse oblique ribs, 2 or 3 of these winglike, to ca. 5 mm long.

Liana or climbing shrub (rarely elsewhere a small tree or shrub); young stems and petioles densely short appressed-pubescent. Leaves oblong-elliptic, acumi- nate, acute to obtuse at base, 10-17 cm long, 3.5-6(-7.5) cm wide, glabrate, sometimes with small glands near the margin at the base; petioles to 1.2 cm long, eglandular. Inflorescences paniculate, solitary, terminal or upper axillary to 12 cm long; inflorescence branches, pedicels and sepals with dense, ferruginous, T-shaped trichomes. Flowers 9-13 mm wide; sepals lanceolate to oblong, re- curved at apex, eglandular or with glands covering the lower 1/2, 2.5-4 mm long; petals yellow, clawed, 4-5 mm long, glabrous; stamens 10, 3-4 mm long, equal, enlarged and fused at base, the anthers ca. 1 mm long; styles 3, distinct, truncate at apex, its adaxial angle stigmatic, acute, the abaxial angle apiculate about equall- ing the stamens. Samaras membranaceous, ferruginous-tomentose, especially the body, 2-3 cm long, narrowly elliptic to subobovate, the dorsal margin almost straight, the ventral margin slightly undulate, narrowed near the base, with a small protrusion on the apical end near the body.

Shrubby liana, shrub or small tree to ca. 7 m tall; the stems densely reddish- brown appressed-pubescent when young, becoming glabrous or nearly so, smooth or conspicuously and sparsely lenticellate. Leaves opposite, oblong, oblong-el- liptic or ovate-oblong, acuminate at the apex, obtuse to rounded at the base, 11- 35 cm long, 5-10 cm wide, moderately thick, drying brown, glabrous above, glabrous to minutely appressed-pubescent beneath, major lateral veins 9-14 pairs, the reticulate veins prominulous on the lower surface; petioles 7-10 mm long, canaliculate on upper side, minutely wrinkled on drying. Inflorescences terminal, paniculate, the axils, peduncles, pedicels and calyces densely reddish-brown ap- pressed-pubescent; branches often prominently flattened; peduncles to 3.7 mm long, weakly flattened, bibracteolate at the apex, the bracteoles ovate, to 3 mm long, densely appressed-pubescent on both sides; pedicels to 2.3 mm long. Flow- ers yellow, the buds to 3.3 mm long; calyx lobes recurved, glabrous within, biglandular, the glands oblong, to 2.3 mm long; stamens to 3 mm long, glabrous, the styles slightly longer than the stamens, glabrous the apex in two of them apiculate at the abaxial angle, in the third hooked. Samaras reddish, densely reddish-brown appressed-pubescent, with short T-shaped trichomes, the wings thick, suberose-coriaceous, broadly flabellate-trapezoidal to semidiscoid or re- niform, to 5.8 cm long, 3.5 cm wide, the ventral margin rounded, slightly dentic- ulate, the dorsal margin concave, thickened except at the apex, the body much thickened, to 2.7 cm long, 2 cm wide.

Slender liana; the stems densely reddish-brown appressed-pubescent, becom- ing glabrate to glabrous and densely lenticellate in age. Leaves ovate to ovate- elliptic, acuminate to acute and glandular-tipped at the apex, acute to obtuse or almost rounded at the base, 2-9 cm long, 1.5-4 cm wide, the upper surface glabrous to sparsely pubescent with minute, whitish, T-shaped trichomes, the lower surface paler, densely pubescent with appressed, reddish-brown, T-shaped trichomes, also with scattered, plate-shaped glands along the margin in the distal 1/4 of the blade; petioles 5-8 mm long, glandular or eglandular, densely appressed- pubescent. Inflorescences paniculate, terminal and on short axillary branches, to ca. 15 cm long, the rachises, peduncles, pedicels and calyces densely reddish- brown appressed-pubescent; peduncles to ca. 2 mm long, bibracteate at the apex, the bracts ovate, glabrous within, sparsely pubescent outside; the pedicels to 3 mm long at anthesis, to 5 mm long in fruit. Flowers pink; calyx lobes biglandular, 1.3-2 mm long, the glands dark, round or ellipsoid, contiguous, to ca. 1.5 mm long; petals pink, obovate, ca. 4 mm long, glabrous, entire, somewhat thickened medially; stamens to 3 mm long, the filaments glabrous, the lower ?3-?/2 united; pistil to ca. 3 mm long, ovary densely reddish-brown pubescent, the styles gla- brous, to ca. 2 mm long. Samaras reddish-brown, 2.5-3.5 cm long, 9-15 mm wide, the wing inconspicuously appressed-pubescent, the dorsal margin thick- ened, straight, the ventral margin thin, rounded, gradually narrowed to the body; body darker, densely patulous-pubescent, bearing 1 or more cristate, lateral ap- pendages 2-4 mm long, if several one is usually broader with 1 or more narrower crests borne on its inner edge from near the base.

Liana; stems densely reddish-brown appressed-pubescent, becoming glabrate. Leaves opposite, elliptic to obovate-elliptic, acuminate at the apex and usually narrowed to a sharp apiculum, acute at the base, 5-13 cm long, 2-7.5 cm wide, glabrous on the upper surface, minutely muricate, the lower surface minutely muricate and whitish to brownish sericeous, frequently glandular, the trichomes usually of 2 types, the surface completely covered with fine, sessile, T-shaped trichomes to ca. .7 mm long and with sparse, to 1 mm long, stalked hairs, with a thicker body, usually darker in color than the sessile trichomes; glands of lower surface few to absent, usually in a row ca. midway between the midrib and margin; petioles 3-13 mm long with a pair of small glands appressed at the base on the upper side. Inflorescence upper axillary or terminal, 4-18 cm long, the axis, peduncles, pedicels and calyx lobes densely reddish-brown appressed-pu- bescent; pedicels sessile, not articulate. Flowers yellow; calyx lobes ovate, erect, biglandular, to 2 mm long; petals obovate-spatulate, to 3.3 mm long, clawed, the margins entire to weakly toothed; stamens to ca. 3 mm long, the staminal tube glabrous, to 1.7 mm long, the anthers to 1.2 mm long; pistil to 3.3 mm long, the ovary ovoid, densely reddish-brown pubescent, the styles to 1.7 mm long, gla- brous. Samaras brown, 3-4 cm long, glabrous to inconspicuously appressed- pubescent throughout; the body ovoid-ellipsoid, to ca. 1 cm long, the dorsal margin straight, thickened, the wing 12-14 mm wide near the apex, constricted in the middle to lower 1/3 becoming broader and ending abruptly near the base of the body.

Herb, annual, the stem erect, 0.3-1.2 m high, more or less tomentose, the hairs simple and/or stellate. Leaves long-petiolate, the petiole rather slender, usually longer than the blade, more or less tomentose, the stipules early caducous; blade broadly ovate to subeircular to very broadly ovate, deeply cordate at the base, more or less abruptly long-acuminate at the apex, crenulate or crenate- dentate at the margin, up to 20 cm broad, chartaceous, slightly discolor, 7- to 9-palminerved, puberulus and usually with stellate hairs on both surfaces but the indumentum usually softer and denser beneath, the veins prominent beneath. Flowers axillary and solitary, or in a few-flowered, leafy, terminal panicle, the pedicels shorter than the petioles, articulate usually above the middle, tomentose; calyx broadly campanulate, ca 10 mm long, tomentose, lobed to far beyond the middle, the lobes patent at anthesis, ovate and acute, accrescent; petals patent at anthesis, oblong-obovate, ca 10-13 mm long, yellow or orange, glabrous at the insertion of the staminal tube; androecium shorter than the calyx and corolla, the staminal tube much inflated, glabrous. Fruit broadly cylindric, umbilicate, villous to densely pubescent, the mericarps about 15, 12-15 mm long (awns excluded), long-aristate at the apex, the awns widely spreading and ca 3-5 mm long, rounded at the base, rigid-chartaceous, 3-seeded; seeds ca 3.5-4 mm long, inconspicuously foveolate and minutely puberulus.

Suffrutex herb or shrub up to 4 m high, the stem stellate-puberulus or stellate- hirtellous (mostly along longitudinal lines) and aculeolate, the prickles pustular- based and pointed downwards. Leaves with the petioles slender, up to 10 cm long, stellate-hirtellous and aculeolate, the stipules linear-subulate; blade cordate at the base, 3(-5)-lobed mostly to below the middle (at least the lower leaves), the lobes ovate to narrowly ovate, the sinuses acute and the apex acuminate, the blade of the upper leaves sometimes sub-3-lobed to simple and obtuse at the base, dentate- serrate at the margin, up to 12 cm long, 5- to 7-palminerved, hirtellous with simple and stellate hairs on both surfaces, the venation slightly prominent beneath, the main veins generally shortly aculeolate and the midvein with a small, basal, elongate gland on the lower surface. Flowers solitary in the upper leaf axils, the pedicel articulated, 2-7 cm long, stellate-hirtellous and aculeolate or hispid; epicalyx oif 9-13 bractlets, these linear, unequally bifurcate at the apex, ca 2 cm long, hirsute to hispid with pustular-based hairs, slightly accrescent; calyx lobed to the middle or slightly below, (1-) 1.4-1.8 cm long, accrescent and up to 2.3 cm long in fruit, hirsute to hispid with pustular-based hairs, the lobes deltoid, acumi- nate, prominently 3-nerved, the lateral veins very close to the margin (thickened margin), the midvein of each lobe with an oblong gland; petals cuneate-obovate, rounded at the apex, (5-)7-9 cm long, rose, sometimes purple-striate; staminal tube about V2 as long as (to more or less equalling?) the corolla, antheriferous throughout; style branches exceeding the staminal tube, the stigmas hirtellous. Capsule surrounded by and slightly shorter than the accrescent calyx, broadly ovoid, acuminate and mucronulate, ca 2-2.2 cm long, the mucro ca 2 mm long, the valves rigid-chartaceous, appressed-sericeous; seeds angulate, 3-4 mm long, sparsely and very minutely papillate.

Shrub up to 7 m high, the branchlets glabrous or nearly so. Leaves rather short-petiolate, the petiole up to 3 cm long, the stipules lanceolate-subulate; blade ovate, subcuneate, rounded or truncate at the base, acute to more or less long- acuminate at the apex, irregularly and coarsely serrate at the margin, up to 12-15 cm long and 7-9 cm wide, membranous, glabrous or nearly so, 5- or 7-palminerved, the nerves prominent beneath. Flowers large, axillary, solitary, the pedicels short to usually elongate and slender, articulated above the midde, up to 12.5 cm long, glabrous or sparsely minutely stellate-puberulus; epicalyx or 5-7 bractlets, these free, narrowly ovate, acute, 0.7-1 cm long, sparsely minutely stellate-puberulus; calyx tubular-campanulate, lobed, 10-nerved, 1.8-2.4(-3) cm long, sparsely minutely stellate-puberulus, the lobes deltoid, acute, 0.5-0.8 cm long; petals broadly cuneate- obovate, rounded at the apex, entire to more or less deeply rounded-crenate at the margin, 8(6-10) cm long, usually bright red; staminal tube exceeding the corolla, long-exserted and up to 11-12 cm long, 5-lobed at the apex, antheriferous on the upper part, the filaments about 6-9 mm long; style about 1 cm longer than the staminal tube, the branches up to 1 cm long, sparsely villous, the stigmas hirtellous. Capsule not seen.

Herb, annual, 0.5-2 m high, the stem glabrous or sparsely puberulus. Leaves long-petiolate, the petiole up to 6.5 cm long, glabrous or sparsely puberulus, the stipules narrowly triangular, acute; blade polymorphic, simple and ovate-acute to usually 3- to 5- to 7-palmatifid, the lobes verry narrowly elliptic and acute, with acute sinuses, serrulate or crenulate at the margin, up to 12-15 cm long, glabrous, the midrib prominent and bearing a subbasal gland beneath. Flowers axillary, solitary or in racemiform, terminal inflorescences by reduction of the upper leaves, the pedicel short and stout, 5-7 mm long; epicalyx of ca 10 bractlets, these linear-ovate, united basally and adnate to the base of the calyx, ca 8-12 mm long, sparsely hirsute especially toward the base, accrescent; calyx cupuliform, lobed to about or to below the middle, 1.5-2.2. cm long, deep red, much accrescent, up to 3.5 cm long in fruit and becoming with the epicalyx fleshy and dark red or purple, the lobes ovate, acute, strongly 3-nerved, usually with an elongate gland on the midvein of each lobe, sparsely hirsute especially toward the base; petals cuneate- obovate, rounded at the apex, 3-5 cm long, cream-colored or yellow, often tinged with red; staminal tube much shorter than the corolla. Capsule much shorter than the accrescent calyx, subglobose, apiculate, 1.8-2 cm long, appressed-hirsute; seeds reniform-angulate, 3-5 mm long, very minutely puberulus.

Suffrutex or shrub up to 1.5 m high, covered with simple and 4-rayed, strigose hairs, the rays approximate in pairs. Leaves with the petiole slender, up to 2.5 cm long, strigose, the stipules lanceolate, acuminate, 5-10 mm long; blade oblong- lanceolate to rounded-ovate, broadly cuneate to sometimes truncate at the base, acute or obtuse at the apex, coarsely serrate, at the margin, 3-8 cm long, the nerva- tion prominent beneath, strigose on both sides, the indumentum however denser on the lower surface. Flowers axillary, solitary or in glomerules, the individual flow- ers sessile or shortly pedicellate, the pedicel up to 5 mm long; epicalyx bractlets linear-subulate, acute, 3-6 mm long and 0.5-1 mm broad, hispid; calyx broadly campanulate, 5-costate, lobed to or slightly below the middle, 5-7 mm long, strigose, the lobes ovate, acuminate, ciliolate; petals 8-9 mm long and 4-6 mm broad, the claw barbate; androecium slightly shorter than the calyx, the staminal tube ca 3-3.5 mm long, glabrous; styles 5-6 mm long, connate in the lower part. Mericarps 10-12, dorsally sulcate, ca 2 mm long and 1-1.2 mm thick, the apex provided with an erect awn ca 1-1.5 mm long, with 2 short, dorsal awns ca 0.5 mm long near the middle, dorsally and in part laterally minutely stellate-puberulus and hispid toward the apex.

Herb, annual or biennial, the stem erect, simple or more or less branched above, up to more than 1 m high, the branches suberect, pubescent with simple and/or stellate hairs. Leaves short-petiolate, the petiole 3-10 mm long, pilose, the stipules filiform to narrowly lanceolate, 4-7 mm long, pilose; blade linear or nar- rowly lanceolate, rounded or truncate or infrequently shallowly subcordate at the base, acute at the apex, entire-margined, 2-14 cm long and 2-15 mm broad, 3-nerved from the base, pubescent with simple and/or stellate hairs, the indumentum usually denser beneath, the main veins prominulous beneath. Inflorescences termi- nal, corymbiform or short-racemose, 8- to 20-flowered. Flowers with the pedicel 6-15 mm long, articulated 2-3 mm below the apex, hirtellous; calyx campanulate, subterete, 4.8-7 mm long, hirtellous to hirsute, persistent, the lobes triangular, acute, ca 2-4 mm long and 2.5-3 mm broad at the base; petals obovate, 8-15 mm long and 4-5 mm wide, cream-colored or whitish, usually with a maroon or dark purple center; staminal tube ca 2-3 mm long, minutely hyaline-puberulus near the apex, the filaments 0.5-1.0 mm long; styles 5-6 mm long, connate basally. Mericarps (5-)7-9, trigonous, shortly 2-apiculate, 2.5-3.5 mm long, papyraceolus, dull, brownish-black, glabrous, the lateral walls fragile and fragmenting at ma- turity; seeds ca 2 mm long, dull, dark brown, glabrous except for a few minute hairs around the hilum.

Herb or suffrutex, annual or perennial, the stem erect, up to 1.2 m high, slender and sparingly branched, densely and minutely stellate-puberulus, at length glabrescent. Leaves with the petiole slender, 3-15 mm long, sometimes with 2 more or less spinose, infrapetiolar callosities, minutely stellate-tomentellous, the stipules subulate-filiform, 4-6 mm long, hirtellous, at length caducous; blade polymorphic, lanceolate, linear-lanceolate or linear-oblong, seldom narrowly elliptic, rounded or truncate or infrequently shallowly subcordate at the base, acute or obtuse at the apex, crenate-serrate at the margin, 2-6 cm long and 0.3-1.8 cm broad, markedly discolor, 3- or 5-palminerved, the upper surface dark green (brownish when dry), minutely stellate-puberulus, and with the venation impressed, the lower surface pale, minutely and softly stellate-tomentellous, and with the venation prominent. Flowers axillary, solitary, often with a very short accessory flowering branchlet in the same axil, the flowers toward the apex of the branches and branchlets sub- corymbose, the pedicel slender, articulated mostly above the middle, 2-9 mm long, minutely stellate-tomentellous; calyx cupuliform, 5-angulate, ca 5-5.5 mm long, 10-ribbed, minutely stellate-tomentellous, very moderately accrescent, the lobes deltoid, acute to acuminate, ca 2-2.5 mm long and broad at the base; petals strongly oblique, ca 6-7 mm long, orange (or yellow?); androecium ca 3.5-4 mm long, the staminal tube ca 3 mm long, minutely pilosulose, the filaments relatively few;  styles ca 3.5-4 mm long, connate basally. Mericarps 5, trigonous, ca 2.5 mm long, shortly 2-aristate at the apex, the awns ca 0.5-0.8 mm long, antrorsely pilosu- lose as is the dorsal upper part, the dorsal lower part membranous, the lateral walls membranous-chartaceous and striate-reticulate, apically dehiscent but the seed escaping thru the disintegrated base; seeds trigonous, ca 1.5 mm long, glabrous.

Herb, sometimes suffrutex, the stem slender, usually erect, rarely procumbent, up to 2.5 m high, branched often from the base, rather sparsely hirsute with long, patent, mostly simple or sometimes few-armed, yellowish hairs, and often also with shorter stellate hairs. Leaves with the petiole 1.4-5 cm long, more or less densely hirsute, the stipules subulate, ca 3-4 mm long, hirsute, caducous; blade ovate, sometimes narrowly so, cordate at the base, gradually long-acuminate at the apex, serrate at the margin, up to 10 cm long and 5 cm broad, thin, nearly concolorous, 5- to 9(sub-li)-palminerved, more or less strigose-pubescent on both sides, the indumentum denser on the prominulous primary veins beneath, the hairs simple to few-armed or stellate. Flowers mostly in axillary or subterminal, few- to several- flowered glomerules, those toward the apex of the branches and branchlets often simulating spike-like inflorescences, the individual flowers subsessile to short- pedicellate; calyx campanulate, subplicate-5-angulate, ca 8 mm long, membra- nous, 10-ribbed, yellowish-hispid or subsetose on veins and along margins, moderately accrescent, the lobes broadly triangular, from the base gradually long- acuminate, ca 4.5-5 mm long and 4-4.5 mm broad at the base; petals broadly obovate-cuneate, oblique, sometimes inconspicuously so, usually emarginate at the apex, ca 7(9) mm long and 5(6) mm broad, pale buff, salmon, white or yellow, often reddish at the base, very minutely hyaline-puberulus at the claw; androecium ca 5 mm long, the staminal tube ca 2.5 mm long, sparsely hispidulous, the fila- ments relatively few; styles ca 4 mm long, connate basally. Mericarps 5, trigonous, 2-2.5 mm long, muticous to very shortly and bluntly 2-aristate at the apex, char- taceous, glabrous or somewhat puberulus near the apex, dorsally nearly smooth, laterally faintly striate, dehiscent apically; seeds trigonous, ca 1.5 mm long, gla- brous but minutely puberulus around the hilum.

Suffrutex up to ca 3 m tall, the stem and branchlets sparsely to densely tomen- tose. Leaves with the petiole terete, up to 4 cm long, gradually shorter toward the apex of the stem and branchlets, sparsely to densely tomentose, the stipules ca 2-3 mm long; blade subcircular to ovate to oblong, subentire to angulate to 3-5-pal- matilobed or palmatiparted, cuneate or rounded or cordate at the base, the lobes  entire to pinnatisect, with rounded or acute sinuses and acute to obtuse at the apex, the margins often irregularly serrate, up to 12 cm long and broad, discolor, soft to scabridulous, 3- to 9-palminerved, puberulus to tomentose on both surfaces but the indumentum usually denser beneath, the venation reticulate and slightly prominent beneath. Flowers with the pedicel ca 3-5 mm long, tomentose; epicalyx campanu- late, 4-7 mm long, the lobes narrowly ovate, connate in the lower 1/3, acute at the apex, pubescent; calyx usually slightly shorter than the epicalyx, the lobes narrowly ovate and acute, pubescent; petals obliquely obovate, rounded or truncate at the apex, shortly unguiculate, 10-18 mm long, flabellate-veined, puberulus outside, the claw barbate; staminal tube generally sparsely and minutely pilose; style branches exceeding scarcely the staminal tube. Fruit ca 10 mm in diam, the mericarps rounded at the apex, puberulus, dorsally densely glochidiate-echinate; seeds ca 2-3 mm long.

Suffrutex, annual, or shrub, perennial, 1-4 m tall, the branches usually glabres- cent to sometimes densely grayish-pubescent. Leaves long-petiolate, the stipules early or tardily caducous, the blade cordate at the, base, usually deeply 3-lobed and often with 1 or 2 shorter, basal lobes, the lobes deltoid-ovate, with the sinuses often plicate and long-acuminate at the apex, entire-margined, usually 5(-7)-pal- minerved, mostly glabrescent to sometimes densely grayish-pubescent when young. Flowers large, the epicalyx of 3 bractlets, these usually shorter than the corolla, almost as long as broad, cordate at the base, laciniate with few, long, lance-subulate teeth at the apex, persistent; calyx truncate or shallowly 5-denticulate; corolla 3.5-5.5 cm long, pale yellow, turning pink or red; staminal tube about half as long as the corolla, filamentiferous nearly throughout, the filaments all of about the same length.
